sections.content: This public offer defines the terms and conditions for the provision of VPN services by {vpnName}. By using the service, you agree to the terms of use and accept this offer.
sections.title: Public Offer for the Provision of VPN Services

sections.content:
1.1. The Provider ({vpnName}) provides access to the VPN network in accordance with the selected tariff.
1.2. The User pays for the service and complies with the service rules.
1.3. The service includes:
- Provision of a subscription URL to obtain configuration files for connection
- Access to selected locations
- Technical support
- Configuration updates when necessary
sections.title: 1. Subject of the Offer

sections.content:
2.1. The contract is concluded by accepting the offer:
- Selecting a tariff in the Telegram bot or on the website
- Paying for the service
- Confirming payment

2.2. Acceptance of the offer is deemed to be the user's actions to pay for the service.
2.3. The contract is deemed concluded from the moment payment is confirmed.
sections.title: 2. Procedure for Concluding the Contract

sections.content:
3.1. The cost and duration of the service are indicated in the Telegram bot and on the website when selecting a tariff.
3.2. Payment is made using available methods:
- YooMoney (Quick payment)
- P2P card transfer
- Other methods specified in the bot or on the website

3.3. Currently, payments are processed manually.
3.4. After the transfer, to speed up processing, it is recommended to contact support within 5–10 minutes with the receipt attached.
sections.title: 3. Cost and Payment

sections.content:
4.1. The contract is valid until the end of the paid period.
4.2. The user may extend the contract by ordering a new tariff or extending the old one.
4.3. The contract may be terminated:
- At the user's initiative
- At the provider's initiative in case of breach of conditions (without refund)
- By agreement of the parties
sections.title: 4. Term of the Contract

sections.content:
5.1. The Provider has the right to:
- Suspend access in case of violation of terms
- Change the technical parameters of the service
- Carry out maintenance work
- Refuse service in case of abuse

5.2. The Provider undertakes to:
- Ensure service availability
- Provide technical support
- Maintain data confidentiality
- Respond to inquiries in a timely manner
sections.title: 5. Rights and Obligations of the Provider

sections.content:

- Receive technical support
- Renew the subscription
- Request information about their data

6.2. The User undertakes to:

sections.title: 6. Rights and Obligations of the User

sections.content:
8.1. Refunds are made in exceptional cases by decision of the administration or support.
8.2. Refunds are not made in case of:

sections.content: This policy describes what technical data {vpnName} processes when operating the website, bot, and VPN service. By using the service, you agree to this policy.
sections.title: Privacy Policy of {vpnName} VPN Service

sections.content:
1.1. {vpnName} respects user privacy and ensures the protection of personal data.
1.2. This policy is developed in accordance with the principles of data minimisation.
1.3. We collect only the data necessary for the functioning of the service.
sections.title: 1. General Provisions

sections.content:
2.1. The service may process:
- User's Telegram ID and username
- Selected tariff and technical subscription status
- Payment data (only for payment confirmation, not stored)
- Technical connection information

2.2. We do NOT collect:
- Passport data
- Phone numbers (except as specified in the partnership section)
- Email addresses (except as specified in the payment section)
- Other information not listed in clause 2.1
sections.title: 2. What Data Is Processed

sections.content:
3.1. {vpnName} adheres to a strict No‑Logs policy:
- No history of visited websites is kept
- No analysis of traffic content
- No connection logs are saved
- No user activity is tracked

3.2. For subscription operation, only aggregated metrics may be processed:
- Total traffic used
- Subscription validity period
- Connection status (active/inactive)
sections.title: 3. No‑Logs Policy

sections.content:
4.1. Collected data is used solely for:
- User registration and authentication
- Issuing and managing VPN subscriptions
- Technical support for users
- Preventing abuse and fraud
- Processing payment transactions
- Notifying about maintenance and service changes
sections.title: 4. Purposes of Data Processing

sections.content:
5.1. Data is stored for the limited time necessary for the service:
- Active subscriptions: for the entire term
- Inactive subscriptions: up to 3 days after expiration
- Payment data: not stored, used only for confirmation

5.2. After the retention period, data is automatically deleted.
sections.title: 5. Data Storage

sections.content:
6.1. {vpnName} applies technical and organisational security measures:
- Data encryption during transmission (TLS/SSL)
- Secure storage in databases
- Restricted access to data
- Regular backups

6.2. Only authorised project team members have access to data.
sections.title: 6. Data Protection

sections.content:
7.1. We do not transfer personal data to third parties, except:
- Payment systems (only data necessary for payment processing)

7.2. We do not sell or transfer data for marketing or other purposes.
sections.title: 7. Transfer of Data to Third Parties

sections.content:
8.1. The user has the right to:
- Obtain information about the processing of their data
- Correct inaccurate data
- Request deletion of their data
- Withdraw consent for data processing
- Receive a copy of their data in a machine‑readable format

8.2. To exercise your rights, contact Telegram support.
sections.title: 8. User Rights

sections.content:
9.1. The web interface may use cookies for:
- User authentication
- Saving theme settings

9.2. The user may disable cookies in browser settings.
sections.title: 9. Cookies and Similar Technologies
